selection_basis: The two clips illustrated with projected participant directions in the original paper, one per condition; not recovery outcomes.

geometry_reference.normalization: Unit-normalize only finite nonzero quaternions whose norm differs from one by at most0.01; retain the norm error. No other pose repair.
geometry_reference.comparison: Both signs; first and last admissible ascending crossings in original record order; unordered spherical minimum-sum matching to author-rendered projected coordinates, with counts and unmatched records explicit.
geometry_reference.evidence_gate: All fixed targets available with48 points; one sign has median angular error<=0.5deg and95th percentile<=2deg under at least one prespecified crossing rule, while the other sign has median error>=5deg under both rules. Otherwise retain unresolved mapping; no automatic outcome launch.
geometry_reference.limitations: A demo match is source-adapter reproduction, not independent human observation or validation of arbitrary timing repairs. Do not tune against confirmation clips.

clock_diagnosis.source_ids: all48 per clip, no filtering by gaze or recovery
methods: ascending crossing multiplicity in original order
first versus last admissible crossing sensitivity
relative wall-clock monotonicity and playback backstep location

release_gate: Freeze an evidenced source-specific adapter separately before any remaining-clip pose labels. Retain unresolved clock/media-origin cases; do not declare complete readiness merely because a sign matches.
